global_elimination: At row k>=1 the x^12 summand contributes q6 to degree (k+1)*7+5. The target J(x)J(x^7) has zero coefficient at every degree congruent to 5 modulo 7, and all other product contributions are nonnegative. Hence q6=0.
result: The width-7 row lemma has the same conclusion as the L>=8 lemma once the next-row zero coefficient is used.
